pares.citacao: p.12: 'must meet a minimum compressive strength of 20 MPa, commonly referred to as M20 grade concrete. M20 is composed of a specific mix of constituents conforming to Section 03300 of the cast-in-place concrete standard specifications of the US Department of State Bureau of Overseas Buildings Operations (USDoD 2006)'
pares.nota: DUVIDOSO: a unica referencia normativa e a especificacao de obra 'Section 03300' (OBO/USDoD), citada para os constituintes do traco, nao para o ensaio nem para a definicao da classe; nenhuma norma de ensaio nem dimensoes. 'M20' e notacao (tipo IS 456) mas a norma indiana nao e citada e a notacao M nao esta na regra da Kie (so Cxx/yy e HA-xx).

pares.citacao: Sec.3.2 (p.5): 'The concrete mixtures conformed to the British Standards, BS 1881: Part 125 [43] and BS EN 12390: Part 2 [44], which is a common practice in Singapore's construction sector.' Ref.[44]: 'Testing Hardened Concrete: Making and Curing Specimens for Strength Test. BS EN 12390: Part 2'
pares.nota: Norma de moldagem/cura (EN 12390-2) e de mistura em laboratorio (BS 1881-125); nao diz cubo nem cilindro nem dimensoes. Tracos e fc adaptados de Wu et al. [31] (Singapura). A EN 12390-2 remete a forma/dimensoes para a EN 12390-1 (cubo ou cilindro) - provete-padrao ambiguo; a decidir.
